task.title: Create and Manage Tags
task.shortdesc: Tag a commit to mark a release or milestone, then push, check out, or delete the tags.

step.cmd: To create a tag, right-click a commit in the view and select . New tags remain local until you push them.

info.p: If the repository has more than one remote, the dialog box includes a Push to remote: option so that you can choose where to push the tag.

step.cmd: To manage existing tags, open the menu and select .

info.p: In the Tags dialog box, you can check out a tag, push a local-only tag to the remote, or delete a tag. The Pushed to column lists the remotes that already contain each tag.
